name: figure
title: Figure
description: One wide image, like a screenshot of the work, with a caption row under it and an optional card of proof over its corner.

image.label: Image
image.help: Shown at its own shape, the width of the page. Empty, it shows a placeholder.

caption_left.label: Caption
caption_left.help: What the image shows, under it on the left.

caption_right.label: Caption, right
caption_right.help: A second, shorter note on the right, like the date or the client.

proof_label.label: Proof card label
proof_label.help: A small label at the top of the card, like "Lighthouse performance".

proof_value.label: Proof card number
proof_value.help: The big number, like "100" or "0.4 s". Left empty, there's no card.

proof_note.label: Proof card note
proof_note.help: A line under the number, like "on a phone, over 4G".

tone.label: Background
tone.help: Tinted is a step from the page colour; dark is the inverse band, like the footer.
